Name: SVE and SDS World Map Integration
Author: vickylchq
Description:
[size=4]只是把两个mod的世界地图整合在一起了。

地图上的人物头像定位会有误差，但是太麻烦所以不调了。

没有使用CP是因为怕大家都编辑世界地图，导致无法生效。

【使用方法】
1. 解压缩
2. 把两个文件夹分别覆盖原mod的文件夹[b]（本mod里只有世界地图）[/b]

另外推荐[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049]Remapping - Minimap Project[/url]，它会自动编辑世界地图，非常之棒！﻿


[i]Just combined the world maps of the two mods.

There might be some inaccuracies in the positioning of character avatars on the map, but it's too troublesome to fix, so I left it as is.

Not using CP is to avoid everyone editing the world map, which could lead to it not working.

[How to Use]  
1. Extract the files.  
2. Replace the original mods' folders by overwriting them with the two folders respectively. [b](this mod only includes the world maps) [/b]

[/i][/size][size=4][i]Additionally, I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049]Remapping - Minimap Project[/url], which automatically edits the world map and is absolutely fantastic![/i]
